macros.name: abutcircleabove
macros.doc: For \abutcircleabove, the shadow is abutted against three tangents to the current circle, that touch at the top of the circle and at the two points 45 degrees to the left and right of the top, and is then given the lowest of the three positions obtained by these abutments.

macros.name: border
macros.doc: \border moves the left and right sides outwards by its first parameter, and raises the top and lowers the bottom by its second parameter.

macros.name: borderto
macros.doc: \borderto enlarges the current rectangle so that its width is at least the first parameter and its height (including depth) is at least the second parameter.

macros.name: ctabutstyle
macros.doc: The abutted expression is set in \ctabutstyle, with an octagonal shadow (of the shape produced by \octagon).

macros.name: cten
macros.doc: \cten draws an edge from x-start to x-end, after shading the start and end points with any shadows associated with these points on the vertex list.

macros.name: ctloopdiameter
macros.doc: The control symbols \ctloopdiameter and \ctabutcircledisp are defined to be 20pt and 5pt respectively, but may be redefined by the user.

macros.name: ctvertexborderlr
macros.doc: The control symbols \ctvertexborderlr and \ctvertexbordertb are defined to be 3pt and 4pt respectively, but may be redefined by the user.

macros.name: ctvertexbordertb
macros.doc: The control symbols \ctvertexborderlr and \ctvertexbordertb are defined to be 3pt and 4pt respectively, but may be redefined by the user.

macros.name: ctvertexstyle
macros.doc: The control symbol \ctvertexstyle is defined to be \displaystyle, but may be redefined by the user.

macros.name: diagram
macros.doc: It executes the diagram program that is its only parameter, and then issues the final state produced by this program as a horizontal box whose height, width, and depth are just enough to enclose all of the symbols and lines in this state, plus the origin (0,0) of the coordinate system.

macros.name: diamond
macros.doc: defines the current shadow to be a square, just large enough to enclose the current rectangle, whose sides have slope (+ or - 1), (+ or - 1).

macros.name: drawcirclehead
macros.doc: draws an arrowhead on the current circle, at the intersection with a directed line segment starting at the center with a slope determined by the first two parameters.

macros.name: drawdashedge
macros.doc: draws the current edge as a dashed line.

macros.name: drawdotedge
macros.doc: draws the current edge as a dotted line.

macros.name: drawedgebar
macros.doc: draws a bar across the end of the current edge.

macros.name: drawedgehead
macros.doc: draws an arrowhead on the current edge at a distance from the start point of p times the length of the edge, where p is the first parameter divided by 100.

macros.name: drawsolidedge
macros.doc: draws the current edge as a solid line.

macros.name: hexagon
macros.doc: defines the current shadow to be a hexagon with two horizontal sides identical with the top and bottom of the current rectangle, and four sides of slope (+ or - 1), (+ or - 2).

macros.name: leftghost
macros.doc: \leftghost sets \xcenter to the left of the current rectangle plus half the width of the hbox.

macros.name: octagon
macros.doc: defines the current shadow to be an octagon inscribed in the current rectangle.

macros.name: outline
macros.doc: draws the current shadow.

macros.name: placed
macros.doc: \placed behaves the same way as \place, except that the coordinates at which the center point is placed are expressed by dimensions rather than numbers.

macros.name: rect
macros.doc: defines the current shadow to be the current rectangle.

macros.name: rightghost
macros.doc: \rightghost sets \xcenter to the right of the current rectangle minus half the width of the hbox.

macros.name: rorect
macros.doc: defines the current shadow to be a rectangle with rounded (i.e. quarter-circle) corners.

macros.name: setcircle
macros.doc: defines the current circle to have a diameter given by the first parameter and a center defined by the second and third parameter.

macros.name: setedge
macros.doc: \setedge makes the current edge a directed line segment from the point “start” given by its first two parameters to the point “end” given by its last two parameters.

macros.name: shadeedge
macros.doc: changes the extent of the current edge, without displacing or rotating it, to exclude the portions of the edge lying within shadows associated with its start and end points.

macros.name: shiftcircle
macros.doc: displaces the current circle by the vector described by its parameters.

macros.name: shiftedge
macros.doc: \shiftedge displaces the current edge by a vector whose length is determined by the <dimen:length> parameter, and whose direction is obtained by rotating the current edge 90 degrees counterclockwise.

macros.name: symmetrize
macros.doc: \symmetrize raises the top or lowers the bottom so that they are equally distant from the center point.
